name: First Doctrine
descriptionTemplate: Ramona gains [Energy:Arg1] Aliemus. {Rouse}: After Ramona plays a card, she gains 1 Arithmetica, up to 3 times per turn.
lore:
Philosophy is a discipline without definitive answers.
It is a river that originates from the dawn of civilization, into which humanity has poured different waters along its course.
She is digging her own channel.
Perhaps one day she will uncover the essence of her existence; perhaps that day will never come.

patch.descriptionTemplate: Ramona gains [Energy:Arg1] Aliemus. {Rouse}: After Ramona plays a card, she gains 1 Arithmetica and increases the Base DMG dealt by Ramona by 10%, up to 3 times per turn.
